import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('head -10 /opt/areloria/package.json')

# Check server
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('head -10 /opt/areloria/server/package.json')
print("Server:", stdout.read().decode())

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('sed -i \'s/"private": true/"private": true,/' /opt/areloria/package.json')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('sed -i \'s/"private": true,/"private": true,\n  "type": "module",/' /opt/areloria/package.json')

# Start
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('cd /opt/areloria && node server/dist/index.js &')
print("Started")
import time
time.sleep(8)
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000/health")

client.close()
